CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERNAMECOMPONENT_SEC
AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameComponent
AS
(
-- '1' -- FNAME --
SELECT
BST.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
,HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(BST.FNAME, BST.MNAME,BST.LNAME)) AS CustomerNameId
,'1' AS NameComponentOrderNumber
,BST.FNAME AS NameComponent
,'1' AS NameComponentTypeId
,NULL AS NameComponentNote
,BST.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,BST.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
,BSTD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSTD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BST ON BST.CLTCODE = BSTD.CLTCODE AND BST.ISLATEST = '1'
WHERE BST.CLTTYPE = 'I'

UNION 

-- '2' -- MNAME --
SELECT
BST.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
,HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(BST.FNAME, BST.MNAME,BST.LNAME)) AS CustomerNameId
,'2' AS NameComponentOrderNumber
,BST.MNAME AS NameComponent
,'2' AS NameComponentTypeId
,NULL AS NameComponentNote
,BST.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,BST.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
,BSTD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSTD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BST ON BST.CLTCODE = BSTD.CLTCODE AND BST.ISLATEST = '1'
WHERE BST.CLTTYPE = 'I'

UNION 

-- '3' -- LNAME --
SELECT
BST.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
,HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(BST.FNAME, BST.MNAME,BST.LNAME)) AS CustomerNameId
,'3' AS NameComponentOrderNumber
,BST.LNAME AS NameComponent
,'3' AS NameComponentTypeId
,NULL AS NameComponentNote
,BST.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,BST.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
,BSTD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSTD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BST ON BST.CLTCODE = BSTD.CLTCODE AND BST.ISLATEST = '1'
WHERE BST.CLTTYPE = 'I'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameComponent FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameComponent;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameComponent_SRC
AS
(
SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CustomerId
,CustomerNameId
,NameComponentOrderNumber
,NameComponent
,NameComponentTypeId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameComponent WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameComponent_TGT
AS(
SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CustomerId
,CustomerNameId
,NameComponentOrderNumber
,NameComponent
,NameComponentTypeId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId
FROM BNKM.CustomerNameComponent
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameComponent_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId, TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
,CASE
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameComponent_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameComponent_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameComponent_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameComponent_DELTA;

---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	[CustomerId] = SRC.CustomerId
	,[CustomerNameId] = SRC.CustomerNameId
	,[NameComponentOrderNumber] = SRC.NameComponentOrderNumber
	,[NameComponent] = SRC.NameComponent
	,[NameComponentTypeId] = SRC.NameComponentTypeId
	,[NameComponentNote] = NULL
	,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,[SourceSystemCode] = 'SEC'
	,[TaskRunId] = 0
	,[WorkFlowId] = 0
	,[InsertDttm] = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.CustomerNameComponent TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameComponent_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameComponent SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId ;



--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerNameComponent
(
CustomerId
,CustomerNameId
,NameComponentOrderNumber
,NameComponent
,NameComponentTypeId
,NameComponentNote
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
CustomerId
,CustomerNameId
,NameComponentOrderNumber
,NameComponent
,NameComponentTypeId
,NULL AS NameComponentNote
,FinancialInstitutionId
,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameComponent
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameComponent;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameComponent_DELTA;

END
